functionalRequirement: Customers shall be able to search for new products in the database by entering item names, and upon successful search, view detailed product information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support search functionality for product names and display detailed product information for 100% of valid search queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to provide a complete search and information retrieval function for products.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return accurate product information with no false positives or negatives for 99.9% of search queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate and reliable search results.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must respond to search queries and display detailed product information within 500 milliseconds for up to 1,000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time search and information retrieval, requiring timely responses for a good user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory per search request to ensure efficient resource management.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for handling multiple concurrent searches and maintaining performance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a user-friendly interface for entering search queries and viewing product information, with clear and intuitive navigation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a search function that is easy for customers to use and navigate.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide clear error messages and suggestions for misspelled or non-existent product names.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input, which may contain errors, and the system should handle these gracefully.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The search functionality must be available 99.9% of the time to ensure consistent access for customers.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the search function, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all search queries and product information transmitted over the network using TLS 1.3.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interactions with the system, which may include sensitive data that needs to be protected.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to search for suggested doctors for consultation based on their symptoms or predicted diseases.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support search functionality for doctors based on user symptoms or predicted diseases and provide a list of suggested doctors for 100% of valid search queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to provide a complete search and doctor suggestion function based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must return accurate and relevant doctor suggestions with no false positives or negatives for 99.9% of search queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate and reliable doctor suggestions based on user symptoms or predicted diseases.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must respond to search queries and display suggested doctors within 500 milliseconds for up to 1,000 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time search and information retrieval, requiring timely responses for a good user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The system must use no more than 100 MB of memory per search request to ensure efficient resource management.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Efficient resource use is critical for handling multiple concurrent searches and maintaining performance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a user-friendly interface for entering symptoms or predicted diseases and viewing suggested doctors, with clear and intuitive navigation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires a search function that is easy for users to use and navigate.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide clear error messages and suggestions for misspelled or non-existent symptoms or diseases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input, which may contain errors, and the system should handle these gracefully.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The search functionality for doctor suggestions must be available 99.9% of the time to ensure consistent access for users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to the search function, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all user symptoms, predicted diseases, and doctor suggestions transmitted over the network using TLS 1.3.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves sensitive user health information, which needs to be protected.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure the integrity of user symptoms, predicted diseases, and doctor suggestions by implementing data validation and integrity checks.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical health information, and the system must ensure that this data is not tampered with or corrupted.
